unit shop.orders
import shop.domain as domain (Money, Cents, `commutative`, `idempotent`)
-- shop.domain uses version 1 of shop.tax; this project's range selects
-- version 2. Both are in the build, and their Bands are different types.
import shop.tax.api as tax (Band)

-- Constructor names are scoped to their unit: this Usd is not domain.Usd.
type Currency is | Usd | Gbp end

type Line is Line price :: Money quantity :: domain.Quantity end

settlement :: Currency -> domain.Currency
lineTotal :: Line -> Money
-- Generic laws quantify over the argument's base type, so these adapters take
-- any Int64; the last law restricts its inputs to Cents.
cheaper :: Int64 -> Int64 -> Int64
roundDown :: Int64 -> Int64
classify :: Int64 -> Band

law `dollars settle in dollars` is
  definition is
    settlement Usd = domain.Usd
  end
end

law `pounds settle in euros` is
  definition is
    settlement Gbp = domain.Eur
  end
end

law `a line total keeps the price currency` is
  definition is
    `for all` (l :: Line) .
      domain.currencyOf (lineTotal l) = (match l with
        | Line p q -> domain.currencyOf p
        end)
  end
  example `two items` is
    l = Line (Money domain.Usd 250) (domain.Quantity 2)
    expect domain.centsOf (lineTotal l) = 500
  end
end

law `the cheaper price does not depend on order` is
  definition is
    `commutative` cheaper
  end
end

law `rounding down to whole dollars is stable` is
  definition is
    `idempotent` roundDown
  end
end

law `rounding down never raises a price` is
  definition is
    `for all` (c :: Cents) . roundDown c <= c
  end
end

law `prices are classified into version 2 bands` is
  definition is
    `for all` (c :: Cents) . tax.rateOf (classify c) <= 25
  end
  example `nothing` is c = 0 expect classify c = Zero end
  example `small` is c = 9999 expect classify c = Low end
  example `large` is c = 10000 expect classify c = High end
end

law `shop.domain keeps version 1 of the bands` is
  definition is
    domain.dutyOf domain.High = 20
  end
end

law `this project sees version 2 of the bands` is
  definition is
    tax.rateOf High = 25
  end
end

unit shop.domain
import shop.tax.api as tax (Band)

-- shop.domain depends on version 1 of shop.tax and offers its Band to its own
-- importers, as if declared here.
export Band

-- A package of reusable types, refinements, definitions and laws. Other units
-- import it by name; its declarations keep their own names, so an importer may
-- declare a Currency or a Usd of its own.
type Currency is | Usd | Eur end

refinement Cents is (c :: Int64 where c >= 0 && c <= 100000000) end

type Money is Money currency :: Currency cents :: Cents end

wrapper Quantity is Int32 where value >= 1 && value <= 1000 end

definition currencyOf (m :: Money) :: Currency is
  match m with | Money c n -> c end
end

definition centsOf (m :: Money) :: Int64 is
  match m with | Money c n -> n end
end

-- The duty on a band, at version 1's rates.
definition dutyOf (b :: Band) :: Int64 is tax.rateOf b end

-- Generic laws are templates: an importer applies them to its own adapters.
law `commutative` (f :: a -> a -> a) requires Eq a is
  definition is
    `for all` (x :: a) (y :: a) . f x y = f y x
  end
end

law `idempotent` (f :: a -> a) requires Eq a is
  definition is
    `for all` (x :: a) . f (f x) = f x
  end
end

-- A published contract: every project that depends on this package implements
-- convert and is tested against these laws.
convert :: Currency -> Money -> Money

law `conversion targets the requested currency` is
  definition is
    `for all` (c :: Currency) (m :: Money) . currencyOf (convert c m) = c
  end
end

law `converting to the same currency changes nothing` is
  definition is
    `for all` (m :: Money) . convert (currencyOf m) m = m
  end
end

unit shop.tax.api
import shop.tax.rates as rates (Band)

-- The package's facade: importers use shop.tax.api, and the names it
-- re-exports are the declarations of shop.tax.rates, not copies.
export Band, rates.rateOf

unit shop.tax.rates

-- Version 1 of the tax bands.
type Band is | Low | High end

definition rateOf (b :: Band) :: Int64 is
  match b with | Low -> 5 | High -> 20 end
end

unit shop.tax.api
import shop.tax.rates as rates (Band)

-- The package's facade: importers use shop.tax.api, and the names it
-- re-exports are the declarations of shop.tax.rates, not copies.
export Band, rates.rateOf

unit shop.tax.rates

-- Version 2 adds a zero band and changes the rates. A build may hold both
-- versions: each dependent sees the one its version range selects.
type Band is | Zero | Low | High end

definition rateOf (b :: Band) :: Int64 is
  match b with | Zero -> 0 | Low -> 10 | High -> 25 end
end
